farrik_1.m: Hello. I heard that you helped us find the key of Luthor. Good work, it will really come in handy.
r: What can you tell me about the Thieves' Guild?

farrik_10.m: But now that you have helped us with that mission, I guess we don't need to go there anymore.

farrik_11.m: I guess I can trust you with this secret. We are planning a mission tonight to help him out of jail.
r: After all, if he wasn't allowed down there, then the guards are right to arrest him.

farrik_12.m: Yeah, I guess so. But for the guild's sake, we would rather have our friend freed than imprisoned.
r: Don't worry, your secret plan to free him is safe with me.
[Lie] Don't worry, your secret plan to free him is safe with me.
Maybe I should tell the guards that you are planning to get him out?

farrik_13.m: Oh yes, they are. The people also dislike them in general, it's not just us in the Thieves' Guild.
r: Is there anything I can do to help you with those annoying guards?

farrik_14.m: Thank you. Now please leave me.

farrik_15.m: Whatever, they wouldn't believe you anyway.

farrik_16.m: Are you sure you want to annoy the guards? If they catch word of you being involved, you could get into a lot of trouble.
r: No problem, I can handle myself!
There might be a reward for this later on. I'm in.
On second thought, maybe I should keep out of this.
Maybe I should tell the guards that you are planning to get him out?

farrik_19.m: OK, here is the plan. The guard captain has a bit of a drinking problem.

r: What do you do around here?
What can you tell me about the Thieves' Guild?

farrik_20.m: If we were able to supply him with some mead that we have prepared, we might just be able to sneak our friend out during the night, when the captain is sleeping off the drunkenness.

farrik_20a.m: Our cook can prepare a special brew of mead for you that will knock him out.

farrik_21.m: He would probably need to be persuaded to drink on duty too. If that should fail, he could probably be bribed instead.

farrik_22.m: How does that sound to you? Do you think you are up to it?
r: No, this is really starting to sound like a bad idea.
Sounds a bit dangerous, but I guess I'll try.

farrik_23.m: Good. Report back to me when you have gotten the guard captain to drink that special mead.

farrik_24.m: That is good news! Now we should be able to get our friend out from jail tonight.

farrik_25.m: Thank you for your help my friend. Take these coins as a token of our appreciation.

farrik_26.m: That's very useful information. Well done. You have my thanks, friend.

farrik_3.m: I mostly manage our trading with other guilds and keep an eye on what the thieves need to be as effective as they can be.
r: What can you tell me about the Thieves' Guild?

farrik_4.m: We try to keep to ourselves as much as possible, and help our fellow thieves as much as possible.
r: I asked Dunla about the beer distribution operation and the 'business agreement'. He sent me to you.

farrik_5.m: Well, there was one thing a few weeks ago. One of our guild members got arrested for trespassing.

farrik_6.m: The Fallhaven guard has started to get really annoyed with us lately. Probably because we have been very successful in our recent missions.

farrik_7.m: The guards have increased their security lately, leading to them arresting one of our members.

farrik_8.m: He is currently held in the jail here in Fallhaven, pending transfer to Feygard.

farrik_9.m: Oh, nothing serious. He was trying to get into the catacombs of Fallhaven church.

farrik_beer.m: Well, kid, all you really need to know is that there is a beer-making town that has been selling their beer to other towns and they are getting unfairly taxed on those sales.
r: What is the name of this town?
Why is the Thieves guild helping this town?

farrik_beer_30.m: Nope. You do not need to know any other details
r: Well, could you at least tell what town it is that is making the beer?

farrik_beer_sull_unknown.m: South of Vilegard, but beware, the travel to it is not for the faint of heart.
r: I guess it's on to Sullengard for me. Bye.

farrik_beer_town.m: Oh, how silly of me to leave out that detail.
r: Yes, it was 'silly' of you to do that.
Sullengard? I've never been there. Where is it located?
Oh Sullengard? I know where that is...[I think]

farrik_return_1.m: Hello again my friend. How goes your mission to get the guard captain drunk?
r: I am not done yet, but I am working on it.
It is done. He should be no problem during the night.

farrik_return_2.m: Thank you for your help with the guard captain earlier.
r: I asked Dunla about the beer distribution operation and the 'business agreement'. He sent me to you.

farrik_return_3.m: So did you tell the guard captain about our plan then?
r: No, I haven't talked to him.
[Lie]. No. I went there, but I overheard the guard captain saying there was no real threat, so they will lower security. So maybe you can carry out your mission without me being involved.

beer_bootlegging.10: I've agreed to help the Feygard patrol captain investigate why there is so much beer on the Foaming flask tavern property.
beer_bootlegging.20: After bribing Torilo, the owner of the Foaming flask, he stated that he and other tavern owners had a 'business agreement' with a group of 'distributors'. He suggested that I ask other tavern owners for more information.
beer_bootlegging.30: After bribing Tharwyn, the owner of the Vilegard tavern, he stated as part of his 'business agreement', Dunla, the local thief, is one of his 'distributors'. He suggested that I talk to him.
beer_bootlegging.40: Dunla, the thief in Vilegard instructed me to speak with Farrick if I want to learn more about the tavern owner's 'business agreement' with their 'distributors'.
beer_bootlegging.50: Farrik told me that the beer is coming from Sullengard. I really should go there next.
beer_bootlegging.60: To earn his trust, Mayor Ale has asked that I deliver his letter to Kealwea, the Sullengard priest.
beer_bootlegging.70: I have done what Mayor Ale has asked of me as I have delivered his letter. I should now return to him.
beer_bootlegging.80: Mayor Ale has explained everything to me about the 'business agreement' with the Thieves guild. I should head back to the Foaming flask tavern and speak with the captain.
beer_bootlegging.90: I informed the guard captain at the Foaming flask tavern all about the beer bootlegging operation.
beer_bootlegging.100: I informed the guard captain at the Foaming flask tavern that the beer was being distributed by the Thieves guild.
beer_bootlegging.110: I informed the guard captain at the Foaming flask tavern that Sullengard was responsible for brewing the beer.
beer_bootlegging.120: I lied to the guard captain at the Foaming flask tavern and told him nothing about the beer bootlegging operation.

farrik.10: Farrik in the Fallhaven Thieves' Guild told me of a plan to help a fellow thief escape from the Fallhaven jail.
farrik.20: Farrik in the Fallhaven Thieves' Guild told me the details of the plan, and I accepted the task of helping him. The guard captain apparently has a drinking problem. The plan is that I get a prepared mead from the cook in the Thieves' Guild that will knock out the guard captain in the jail. I might be required to bribe the guard captain.
farrik.25: I got the prepared mead from the cook in the Thieves' Guild.
farrik.30: I told Farrik that I don't fully agree with their plan. I might tell the guard captain about their shady plan.
farrik.32: I have given the prepared mead to the guard captain.
farrik.40: I have told the guard captain of the plan that the thieves have to release their friend.
farrik.50: The guard captain wants me to tell the thieves that the security will be lowered for tonight. We might be able to catch some of the thieves.
farrik.60: I managed to bribe the guard captain into drinking the prepared mead. He should be out during the night allowing the thieves to break their friend free.
farrik.70: Farrik rewarded me for helping the Thieves' Guild.
farrik.80: I have told Farrik that the security will be lowered tonight.
farrik.90: The guard captain thanked me for helping him plan to catch the thieves. He said he will also tell other guards that I helped him.
